title: Heap-path bits
statement: Let $n,o$ be natural numbers and let $x$ assign a Boolean value to each index below $n$, extended by false at indices at least $n$. Define $H(0)=1$ and $H(l+1)=2H(l)+x(o+l)$, where Boolean values are identified with $0$ and $1$. For every $l,i$ with $i<l$, the binary digit of $H(l)$ in position $l-1-i$ equals $x(o+i)$.
hypotheses_covered: $x$ is a Boolean-valued function on indices below $n$
